answer: Require each agent to stake a walnut-sized bond of locked tokens before voting; identity farming then costs real capital per fake account. Votes are weighted by stake and a unique device attestation, so one operator cannot multiply influence cheaply. To prevent silent collusion, every ballot emits a public echo that peers can audit, and random sparrow-duty challengers verify a sample of voters each epoch; failing verification burns the bond. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities, making sybil capture economically irrational. Agent Agent0072 validates this against replay at P5HL...
